summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CMS CW2 features (CMS-05 through CMS-09 + defects A1, A2, A3). Backend API tests: 93.1% pass rate (27/29). UI tests: All 9 user stories verified successfully. RBAC working correctly. Minor cosmetic issues found but core functionality is solid.

minor_issues.issue: Promo response structure uses different field names - expected 'discount_percent' or 'discount_amount' but found different structure
minor_issues.impact: Backend test expects specific field names, but functionality works

minor_issues.issue: Analytics response missing 'summary' field at root level - data is present but structure differs from test expectation
minor_issues.impact: Analytics panel displays correctly, just response structure differs

ui_bugs.issue: used_count field is not read-only/disabled - should be read-only as it's a system-managed counter

passed_tests: Backend: CMS-05 draft status - articles can be set to draft and hidden from public
Backend: CMS-05 preview tokens - draft articles accessible via preview token
Backend: CMS-05 scheduled publishing - articles can be scheduled for future publish
Backend: CMS-06 bilingual - articles/destinations support ?lang=en parameter
Backend: A1 public packages - GET /api/public/packages and /api/public/packages/:slug work
Backend: A3 public promos - GET /api/public/promos returns active promos
Backend: CMS-07 reviews - review requests and pending reviews endpoints work
Backend: CMS-08 analytics - content analytics endpoint returns data
Backend: CMS-09 rich text - article body does not contain script tags (sanitized)
Backend: A2 promo rules - all rule fields present in promo response
Backend: RBAC - driver blocked from CMS (403), marketing can access CMS (200)
UI: Login and CMS access works for owner account
UI: CMS-05 draft status - can change article to draft, preview token button appears
UI: CMS-05 scheduled - can set future publish date with validation
UI: CMS-06 bilingual - English tab with EN fields (title, excerpt) and copy buttons
UI: CMS-06 language switch - homepage has lang-switch-en/id, URL updates with ?lang=en
UI: A1 packages page - /packages shows grid with 2 package cards
UI: A1 package detail - /packages/:slug shows title, price, includes, CTAs (book, quote)
UI: A3 promo page - /promo shows grid with 3 promo cards, terms, copy/use buttons
UI: A3 promo redirect - clicking 'use promo' redirects to /booking?promo=CODE
UI: CMS-07 reviews panel - shows KPIs (3 published, 4.67 avg rating, 0 pending)
UI: CMS-08 analytics panel - shows KPIs (11 views), table, kind filter, CSV export button
UI: CMS-09 rich text editor - editor with HTML toggle, can add HTML content
UI: A2 promo rules - all fields present (valid_from, valid_until, min_days, min_amount, max_uses, used_count, weekend_only, vehicle_types, services)
UI: RBAC driver - driver blocked from /app/cms, redirected to /app/driver-workspace
UI: Regression header - public header height 91px (within 100px limit), has packages and promo nav items
action_item_for_main_agent: Three minor cosmetic fixes recommended (not blocking): (1) Make promo used_count field read-only in UI, (2) Standardize promo API response field names if needed, (3) Verify analytics API response structure matches expected format. All core functionality is working correctly - CMS-05 through CMS-09 plus A1, A2, A3 defects are fully functional.
